reference_sql:
WITH channels AS (SELECT DISTINCT channel FROM orders),
countries AS (SELECT DISTINCT ship_to_country FROM orders),
march AS (SELECT channel, ship_to_country, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY channel, ship_to_country)
SELECT ch.channel, co.ship_to_country, COALESCE(m.n_orders, 0) AS n_orders
FROM channels ch
CROSS JOIN countries co
LEFT JOIN march m ON m.channel = ch.channel AND m.ship_to_country = co.ship_to_country

solver.query:
WITH grid AS (
  SELECT ch.channel, co.ship_to_country
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT channel FROM orders) ch
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ship_to_country FROM orders) co
), mar AS (
  SELECT channel, ship_to_country, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY channel, ship_to_country
)
SELECT g.channel, g.ship_to_country, COALESCE(m.n_orders, 0) AS n_orders
FROM grid g
LEFT JOIN mar m ON m.channel = g.channel AND m.ship_to_country = g.ship_to_country
